name: beverage-distributor
description: Sistema de gestão para distribuidora de bebidas — produtos, PDV, financeiro e relatórios

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/api && npm run test --workspace packages/shared && npm run test --workspace apps/web
scripts.db:seed: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run db:seed --workspace apps/api
scripts.db:seed:fixtures: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run db:seed:fixtures --workspace apps/api
scripts.db:reset: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run db:reset --workspace apps/api
